content:
Successfully completed the Be10x AI Tools & Claude Workshop on October 18, 2026, exploring AI-powered tools for productivity, research, development, data analysis, content creation, and workflow automation. 

Tools explored:

NotebookLM — AI-powered research and information synthesis
Google Stitch and Google AI Studio — UI design and AI-assisted application development
Wispr Flow — AI-powered voice dictation
Claude and Claude Code — AI-assisted problem-solving and coding
Julius — Data analysis and visualization
Claude Skills — Reusable AI workflows for repetitive tasks
Higgsfield — AI video and advertisement creation
ElevenLabs — AI voice generation and conversational voice agents

The workshop introduced practical ways to apply AI tools to real-world business problems and improve productivity.
